review_notes: Read the whole target file and the sibling TanTheta/Spectrum.lean (lines ~130-250). The coercivity argument in `coercive_of_selfAdjoint_spectrum_exterior` is a near line-for-line copy of `coercive_of_compress_spectrum_exterior`. The structure and bundle lemmas in the target (`residual_eq_sub_starProjection` and the like) are short and routine, so I did not flag them. I did not check Sylvester/Spectrum.lean and Riccati/BoundedExistence.lean closely. They also call `norm_ringInverse_le`, but their statements differ, so I made no claim about them. I did not compile the proposed refactor. It assumes `compressOperator Z T v` coerces definitionally to `Z.starProjection (T v)`, which the existing `show ... from rfl` in Spectrum.lean line 211 supports. It also assumes the lemma can be moved above `coercive_of_compress_spectrum_exterior` in Spectrum.lean, because the target file imports that file.

findings.problem: The proof repeats the nontrivial argument of `coercive_of_compress_spectrum_exterior` in TanTheta/Spectrum.lean. Both build M₁ = M − algebraMap ((α+β)/2) and prove it self-adjoint. Both get the spectral bound from `le_abs_of_spectrum_exterior`, then `IsUnit` from `isUnit_of_forall_le_abs`. Both take `J := Ring.inverse M₁`, use `Ring.inverse_mul_cancel`, bound ‖J‖ by `norm_ringInverse_le`, and derive r‖x‖ ≤ ‖M₁ x‖ by the same two-step `calc` with `mul_inv_cancel₀`. Only the final identification of M₁ x with the centred vector differs. The Spectrum.lean copy specialises to K = ↥Z and M = `compressOperator Z T`. The file even says `le_abs_of_spectrum_exterior` is "Derived here and in `UnboundedSpectrum.lean`", so the duplication is known. A fix to the inverse or coercivity argument must currently be made twice.
findings.proposed_change: Move the general lemma `coercive_of_selfAdjoint_spectrum_exterior` (statement and proof as in the target, about 45 lines) into TanTheta/Spectrum.lean, in namespace `TauCeti.DavisKahanExt` next to `le_abs_of_spectrum_exterior`. It needs no unbounded-operator material, and UnboundedSpectrum.lean already imports Spectrum.lean. Then shorten `coercive_of_compress_spectrum_exterior` to the general lemma applied with K := ↥Z, M := compressOperator Z T and the vector ⟨x, hx⟩. That lemma is `isSelfAdjoint_compressOperator hT Z`. Its closing `calc` only needs `‖(compressOperator Z T v : E) - c • (v : E)‖ = ‖Z.starProjection (T x) - c • x‖`, which holds by `rfl` (Spectrum.lean line 211 already uses `show ... from rfl` for the first part). The ~50-line `set M₁ … hval` body in Spectrum.lean then becomes a few lines. The target file keeps only a call to the shared lemma, as it already does in `hZcoercive`.
findings.benefit: The inverse-based coercivity argument is stated and proved once, so the two versions cannot drift apart. The compressed-block lemma shrinks to its real content, the identification of the centred compression with the ambient vector expression. The relation between the bounded and unbounded tan Θ developments becomes explicit instead of living in a comment.
